QuantWare Contralto-A17

QuantWare

QuantWare Contralto-A17

QuantWare · superconducting circuits · DEPLOYED (sold as a QPU; 'Shipping now' on QuantWare's A-line page, Sep 2026; early access since Feb 2025) (2026 (GA; early access Feb 2025)) · 17 physical qubits · access: sold as components
architecture: סריג טרנסמונים עם מצמדים ברי-כוונון · Open on the map

Register profile — the machine's variant of its architecture

qubit type: tunable transmon
gate mechanism: flux-tunable couplers and individual Purcell filters (A-line)
connectivity: planar square lattice, d=3 surface patch
control: room-temperature RF
control placement: room-temp
readout: dispersive
codes: rotated_surface
flags: no published error rates, source not confirmed

Technologies by layer — the machine's cell per layer

1 נושא הקיוביט
טרנסמון · primary ▦ §Introducing Contralto-A (up to 17 flux-tunable transmon qubits); chip photo ✅
tunable transmon, 17 qubits (9 data + 8 ancilla); early access, general access H1 2026 unconfirmed; no fidelity metrics published
2 קידוד
תת-מרחב דו-רמתי חשוף · primary ◌ 🔎
Bare two-level subspace — Computational subspace of an anharmonic oscillator; leakage to |2⟩ is the price.
3 מנגנון השער
CZ / iSWAP במצמד בר-כוונון · primary ▦ §Introducing Contralto-A (tunable couplers and Purcell filters) ✅
flux-tunable couplers with individual Purcell filters (A-line; D-line uses fixed couplers); no gate fidelities published
4 קישוריות והובלה
סריג סטטי של שכנים קרובים · primary ▦ §Introducing Contralto-A (allows distance-3 surface code implementations) 🔎
planar square lattice laid out as a d=3 rotated-surface patch (17 = 9 data + 8 ancilla)
5 בקרה
אלקטרוניקה בטמפרטורת החדר + קואקס/כבל גמיש לכל קיוביט · primary ◌ §Introducing Contralto-A 🔎
no control scheme published for Contralto-A; the page calls it 'a cost-efficient upgrade path to QuantWare's VIO-powered QPUs', i.e. not a VIO device; customer room-temperature RF (register)
6 קריאה
קריאה דיספרסיבית במיקרוגל (+TWPA, מסנן פרסל) · primary ▦ §Introducing Contralto-A (Purcell filters) 🔎
dispersive readout with individual Purcell filters (A-line)
7 קוד
קוד המשטח המסובב (+ גרסאות yoked) · alternate ▦ §Introducing Contralto-A (optimised for running up to a distance-3 surface code) ✅
targeted: d=3 rotated_surface patch (9 data + 8 ancilla); not demonstrated by the vendor
— none — nothing in this layer ▨ 🔎
no code run by QuantWare (L0, customers run codes); Contralto-A positioned as d=3 rotated_surface building block
8 מפענח
— none — nothing in this layer ▨ 🔎
no decoder; sold as a component (register decoder=none)
9 חיבור בין-מודולי
— none — nothing in this layer ▨ 🔎
monolithic single 17-q chip; VIO chiplet tiling (no published chip-to-chip fidelity) is the 2028 VIO-40K target
10 ייצור
ליתוגרפיה של קיוביטים מוליכי-על (צמתי ג'וזפסון Nb/Al, 300 mm) · primary ▨ ✅
superconducting QPU supplier fab; KiloFab (Delft) opens 2026 for a claimed 20× capacity increase
